title: Yellow Gooey Australian Shrimp Skewers
description: A nutty and gooey Australian dish featuring jumbo shrimp, this recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner, it is high in protein and can be prepared in under 30 minutes.
instructions: Preheat the broiler to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together butter, honey, garlic powder, paprika, salt, and black pepper.
Add the chopped macadamia nuts to the bowl and stir until they are well coated with the butter mixture.
Thread the jumbo shrimp onto skewers, leaving a small space between each shrimp.
Brush the shrimp with the lemon juice.
Roll the shrimp in the macadamia nut mixture to coat, pressing the nuts onto the shrimp to help them stick.
Place the skewers on a broiler pan lined with aluminum foil.
Broil the shrimp for 8-10 minutes, or until they are pink and cooked through.
Serve the shrimp hot, garnished with additional chopped macadamia nuts if desired.
